build_geometry_module: build a GeometryModule to encapsulate UV correspondences and vertex images for mesh rendering
compute_face_normals: compute face normals from vertex positions and face indices using face_normals_v2
compute_vertex_normals: compute vertex normals by averaging adjacent face normals using vert_normals_v2
sample_uv_values: sample per-vertex values at UV coordinates using bilinear interpolation via sample_uv
compute_tbn_vectors: compute tangent bitangent and normal vectors for a mesh using compute_tbn
